title: mspp_weblinkset
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_publishingstateid, mspp_websiteid, mspp_websitelanguageid.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_display_name.description: Stores the label that is shown on the user interface (UI) in the data editing mode.

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_name.description: The name of the custom entity.

statecode.description: Status of the Web Link Set

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Web Link Set

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_publishingstateid_value.description: Unique identifier for Publishing State associated with Web Link Set.

_mspp_websiteid_value.description: Unique identifier for Website associated with Web Link Set.

_mspp_websitelanguageid_value.description: Optional language to associate with web link sets for language-specific primary navigation
